name: docxmd
description: Edit Markdown with a live neumorphic preview, LaTeX math, callout blocks, highlights and colour boxes; clean up scientific notation; export to Word (.docx) with headers, footers and page numbers, and import Word back to Markdown — inside VS Code. Companion to the DOCXMD PWA.

docxmd.deeplApiKey.markdownDescription: Your personal DeepL API key, used to translate documents into the interface languages (EN · UK · ES · ZH). Stored locally in your VS Code settings and sent only to DeepL. Get a free key at https://www.deepl.com/pro-api.

enumDescriptions: Save pasted / dropped images to an images/ folder next to the Markdown file and insert a relative link
Embed pasted / dropped images in the text as base64 data-URIs
docxmd.pastedImages.markdownDescription: Where pasted or dropped images go. `folder` writes `images/image-001.png` next to the `.md` and inserts `![…](images/image-001.png)`; untitled documents always embed.

docxmd.notationDictionary.markdownDescription: Dictionary for **DOCXMD: Clean up scientific notation**, one entry per line: `TCore = T_{Core}`, `R2 = R^{2}`, or just `CH4` (digits become subscripts). Empty = the built-in medical list (SpO2, CO2, O2, H2O, HbA1c, PaO2, PaCO2, SaO2, EtCO2, TCore, TPeriphery, TMean, TStd, R2).
